Annual placement report 2024-25

The Department of Medical Laboratory Technology reports that 48 of 52 eligible
graduates accepted an offer within six months of completing the programme. Median
annual compensation was INR 3,60,000. Employers included district hospitals,
diagnostic laboratory chains and public health laboratories. Internship rotations
covered haematology, clinical biochemistry, microbiology and histopathology. This
report is published on the institutional website for prospective students and
accreditation reviewers.
